derivation: Hand-derived from docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-31-phase-3-market-evidence.md Design 1-9, rulings B6/B17 item 3 (docs/rulings/2026-10-31-context-plan.md), Q-X and the questions file; upstream values are copied from the frozen R3 oracle (cases/cp3-cp6-owner/expected.json, cited by line). Written by cases/cp3-context-owner/builder/build.py (stdlib only; no code of the phase is run).

interpretation.locator: line:<n> of the span holding the figure in the rebuilt text; the context span ids are line:1..N (preparation.py:79)
interpretation.citation_quote: indented file: the member's own JSON text alone on its line (`"price": "98.75"`). One-line (minified) file: the member does not sit alone on its line, so the quote is anchored on the quote object (`{` through the figure's closing quote), unique in the line (Design 3).
interpretation.value_class: Python's Quote and As of cells carry value_class `source` (Q-X); Source, Kind and Limitation cells carry none; model-written cells keep analyst_judgment.
interpretation.cell_text: Quote cell and As of cell are the context's own strings; no arithmetic (only whole calendar days for staleness).
interpretation.row_order: model market_evidence rows (m01..) first, then Python rows c01.. in context order, quotes before deal_terms (Design 2).
interpretation.unpinned: The order of the context items within own_limitations, the Basis-cell wording for a context row and the c-row labels are not fixed by the plan; the oracle pins them as stated here (see the report).

cell_notation.text: exact displayed text; null means unsettled
cell_notation.cites: [source_id, locator] per citation, in order; the quote is in the submission row
cell_notation.value_class: analyst_judgment where the cell is model-written
cell_notation.gap_cells: render as the gap spelling with a report-wide G# numbered sequentially in the order of the facts of each module (LEAD ruling Q7); the number is not a literal here
cell_notation.cite_quotes: the quote of each citation, in order, parallel to cites (Python rows only)

upstream.premise: CP-0, CP-1, CP-1A, CP-2 are the R3 positive heads re-run over the pack plus the `context` source; the CP-0 and CP-1 context assessments are the Phase 2 pattern (cases/context-identity-periods/overlays.json). Only the CP-3 report is pinned here.
upstream.inherited_limitations_note: the settled head also inherits the CP-0 context limitation (authority unknown); the report-level own limitations below exclude inherited ones (execution.settle)
